question: How many orders have been placed in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.orders

question: How many customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.customers

question: How many orders were placed through each sales channel?
sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) FROM sales.orders GROUP BY channel

question: How many orders are there in each order status?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM sales.orders GROUP BY status

question: What was our total net revenue in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: What is net revenue by region across all data?
sql: SELECT rg.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN sales.regions rg ON rg.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY rg.name

question: Which 5 products generated the most net revenue overall?
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS rev FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5

question: What was the average order value of completed orders placed in 2026?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'

question: How many customers are in each customer segment?
sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) FROM sales.customers GROUP BY segment

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2026?
sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date)::date, COUNT(*) FROM sales.orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY 1

question: How many returns were there for each return reason?
sql: SELECT reason, COUNT(*) FROM sales.returns GROUP BY reason

question: What was the total amount refunded on returns received in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) FROM sales.returns WHERE returned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND returned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: What is the on-time delivery rate for each shipping method?
sql: SELECT method, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN delivered_at <= shipped_at + promised_days * INTERVAL '1 day' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM sales.shipments WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY method

question: Which region has the most customers?
sql: SELECT rg.name FROM sales.customers c JOIN sales.regions rg ON rg.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY rg.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were shipped by express between July and September 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.shipments WHERE method = 'express' AND shipped_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01' AND shipped_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01'

question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.customers WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

question: How many distinct customers had at least one completed order in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: What was net revenue per sales channel for completed orders in 2026?
sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel

question: Which product category has the most returns?
sql: SELECT p.category FROM sales.returns r JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What fraction of all orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM sales.orders

question: How many products have a list price above 1000 euros?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.products WHERE unit_price > 1000

question: What was monthly net revenue from Laptops in 2025?
sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = 'Laptops' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1

question: Who are our top 3 customers by net revenue across all data?
sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS rev FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many orders are still processing?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'processing'

question: What is the average list price per product category?
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) FROM sales.products GROUP BY category
